description: FleetPy provides an agent-based fleet simulation framework for ride sharing, autonomous mobility and demand-responsive transport. The provider is TUM-VT FleetPy contributors. Geographical and temporal coverage: FleetPy supports configurable vehicle, passenger and operator behaviour in user-defined service areas. The linked provider page supplies the access route and documentation; the resource payload was not retrieved. The licence is MIT. The described material is available without a stated fee. Caveats: The page establishes existence and purpose, but neither completeness nor fitness for a particular simulation was independently tested. For simulation, the documented contents can support transport network modelling and capacity planning. This use is an interpretation of the metadata, not a tested integration. No directly related existing catalogue record was established.
